_help: Prices shown on the map. All amounts in EUR, before the payment app's (CEME, e.g. Miio) own fee.
kwh = price per kWh, min = price per minute, start = fixed fee per session.
'operators' applies to every charger whose OSM operator or network matches the key (case-insensitive, substring match).
'stations' overrides one charger: use its id (shown at the bottom of the charger's card, e.g. osm-node-123456) or its Mobi.E code (e.g. FNC-00012).
Set 'updated' to the date you checked the price so visitors know how fresh it is.
